title: Eze Auction
purpose: An auction-capable classified ads marketplace with bidding, listing drafts, discovery, buyer interactions and checkout components.
stack: Laravel, PHP, Blade, Sanctum, Socialite, Stripe, MySQL-compatible database
subtitle: From a listing draft to bids, discovery and paid placement.
summary: Auction-capable marketplace spanning recoverable listing drafts, photo uploads, bids, comments, favorites, reviews and listing checkout.
overview: The repository inventory describes a Laravel marketplace combining classified ads with a bidding workflow and payment-related code. Its bidding capability is the reason this is distinct from the existing classifieds projects; production auction execution was not independently tested.
focus: A source-described marketplace experience connecting ad publishing, bid engagement and listing checkout.
